added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs on disk, not from its manifest: base-focus.log at 1d16388a carries 55 passed with no FAILED line and head-focus-final.log at eaf52d1a26 carries 60 passed with no FAILED line, so the armed set difference is empty. Cross-checked over the wider admission-importing population: comm -13 of the 165 distinct FAILED ids in base-admission.log and the 164 in head-admission.log is empty, and comm -23 returns one id (tests/test_a_queued_launch_never_classifies_the_fleet.py::test_the_launch_inputs_equal_the_base_except_for_backlog), which is the positive control showing the derivation read both logs rather than finding nothing to read.

findings.summary: the echo assertion's power rests on BUDGET differing from the flight default, and nothing asserts it does
findings.text: non-blocking: assert first["launch_budget_seconds"] == BUDGET compares the pass's echoed figure against the constant the case handed in, and it discriminates now only because BUDGET is 30.0 at line 28 while DEFAULT_ADMISSION_PASS_BUDGET_SECONDS at reckon/flight.py:198 is also 60.0; if a later edit restores BUDGET = 60.0 the case stays green while a pass that ignored its argument and fell through to the default becomes invisible again, which is exactly the regression this repair was made to catch. A one-line assert BUDGET != DEFAULT_BUDGET in test_the_budget_defaults_to_sixty_seconds_from_flight at line 188 would make the relationship a check rather than a coincidence.

findings.summary: the budget control's gloss names both budget cases as red, but the log's two red cases are the launch-count ones
findings.text: non-blocking: the row glosses 2 failed, 3 passed as "both budget cases red against a 30 s budget where the default fits one launch more", yet negative-control-budget.log's failing ids are test_a_pass_stops_when_its_launch_budget_is_spent and test_a_launch_row_carries_its_duration_and_slowest_step, while test_a_pass_with_no_budget_reads_the_flight_value passes by construction because the mutation still reads the flight-published 30 s. The counts are right and the mechanism stated is the right one, but a reader takes the phrase as covering the no-argument case, which that control does not exercise.
